distanceMax.title: Distance Max
distanceMax.description: Setting this at 0 will give an infinite distance limit

focusEntity.title: Focus Entity
focusEntity.description: Entity for the camera to focus on. If blank, then the camera will use the whole scene

frameOnStart.title: Frame on Start
frameOnStart.description: Frames the entity or scene at the start of the application."

inertiaFactor.title: Inertia Factor
inertiaFactor.description: Higher value means that the camera will continue moving after the user has stopped dragging. 0 is fully responsive.

autoRender.title: Auto Render
autoRender.description: Disable to only render when camera is moving (saves power when the camera is still)

cameraEntity.title: Camera Entity
cameraEntity.description: Attach your static camera here to allow zooming

zoomSmoothness.title: Zoom Smoothness
zoomSmoothness.description: Lower is slower, Higher is snappier

linearAngle.title: Linear Angle
linearAngle.description: Direction of the linear gradient in degrees.

radialSmoothness.title: Radial Smoothness
radialSmoothness.description: How soft the radial transition is.

orbitSensitivity.title: Orbit Sensitivity
orbitSensitivity.description: How fast the camera moves around the orbit. Higher is faster

distanceSensitivity.title: Distance Sensitivity
distanceSensitivity.description: How fast the camera moves in and out. Higher is faster

invertMouseX.title: Invert Mouse X
invertMouseX.description: Check this if the interaction moves horizontally opposite to your mouse.

invertMouseY.title: Invert Mouse Y
invertMouseY.description: Check this if the interaction moves vertically opposite to your mouse.

orbitSensitivity.title: Orbit Sensitivity
orbitSensitivity.description: How fast the camera moves around the orbit. Higher is faster

distanceSensitivity.title: Distance Sensitivity
distanceSensitivity.description: How fast the camera moves in and out. Higher is faster

duration.title: Duration (Sec)
duration.description: Time in seconds to fade from black to clear

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: How strong the grain is. Keep below 0.1 for subtlety.

fps.title: Framerate
fps.description: Animation speed of the grain. 24 fps mimics real film.
